entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call is very important to us. Please hold while we connect you with an agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, this is Sarah, how can I help you today?
Yeah, hi Sarah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse I bought. It's not working the way I expected.
I understand. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand Pulse. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with the purchase, please?

It's order #VF12345. Look, I don't have time for this. I just want to return it. It keeps disconnecting from my phone, and the heart rate readings are all over the place. It's basically a glorified smart watch that doesn't work!

Okay, I have your order here. I see the VeloBand Pulse was purchased 15 days ago. I apologize for the inconvenience you're experiencing. Our standard return policy allows for returns within 90 days of purchase. Let me initiate the return process for you.
Ninety days? Really? That's great! I was worried I was stuck with this thing. I appreciate you figuring that out so quickly. So, what do I need to do?

No problem at all! I'll go ahead and generate a return shipping label for you. You'll receive it in your email within the next hour. Simply repackage the VeloBand Pulse, attach the label, and drop it off at any authorized shipping location. Once we receive the returned item, we will process your refund. You should see the refund reflected in your account within 7-10 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Wow, that's fantastic! That's all I needed. Thank you so much for your help! I thought the return policy was much shorter! I was getting worried. I really appreciate it!

You're very welcome! We strive to provide the best possible experience with our products. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Just to confirm, the VeloBand Pulse is being returned and you will receive a pre-paid shipping label to your email for you to ship it back to us. Is there anything else at all I can help with today?
You're welcome! Have a great day!
